title: Ideal way to see & learn about Sevilla
text:
The bike tour guided by Pablo was the highlight of our visit to Seville! Biking was the best way to see the city in a short period of time and Pablo was a very knowledgeable guide stopping frequently to point out the sites and provide the history. 
We highly recommend Pablo and Seville Bike Tour. You will not be disappointed!
author: H786VVdanielh

title: Pablo the history genius
text: My favorite experience during Spain/Portugal visit.  Pablo, my guide, is a history genius.  We traveled all around the city including Triana - he tied historical events to the architcture - pointed out moorish, jewish, christian features (even on the same building!)  Showed where locals go on first dates and yummy taco spots.  We talked about current events - but best to just hear him riff on history.  He was wonderful!
author: sarahwN48CZ

title: Bike tour of Seville
text:
This was one of the best bike tours we have ever done in Europe! This company was kind, friendly & amazing. Our tour guide- Pablo was absolutely wonderful!  He was passionate & very knowledgeable in telling us the history of his city. He was easy going, humorous, & never made us feel rushed. We covered so much of this city & saw many places. 
Thank you so much Pablo for a very enjoyable tour of Seville!
author: maureenhI9601DI

title: Fantastic, informative city tour
text: Definitely one of the highlights of our week in Seville! The 3 hour bike tour was fun and entertaining. We learnt so much from our guide Albaro ( not sure of his name spelling), who was so knowledgeable and passionate about his city. A previous student of history and archaeology he was able to give us so much detail about Sevilles colourful past and buildings, Stopping regularly to  describe details in the buildings or landscape we would never have spotted. We saw a great deal more of the city then we would on foot, the bikes were in good do condition and helmets provided if needed. Excellent
author: wonderwoman41

title: Pablo was a fantastic...
text: Pablo was a fantastic tour guide. So knowledgeable and funny! He tailored our tour to meet our needs. A great way to see lots of the city! Would highly recommend!!
author: Staci_M

title: Greatest tour ever
text: We loved this tour.  Our guide was so nice and knowledgeable.  We learned so much about Seville.  We would do it again all day!
author: 16devond

title: Everything was on wheels
text: We had previously gone to Seville and wanted to do something different. Looking we found this activity and saw it at a good price. It was much better than the idea we got. It's a pretty nice way to visit the city. They took care of us pretty well. We booked through their website and "everything went on wheels" :D
author: 312nachog

title: Fantastic cycling tour with Pierre
text: Really enjoyed this. Great way to see the highlights with kids. Highly recommended. Thank you - would do again.
author: Liddy_P

title: A great intro to Seville
text:
Take three friends aged 55-66 add bikes and a decent guide; brilliant!
Pitched the pace and the chat perfectly.
author: Nigel_H

title: Seville on wheels!
text: Great tour with Emilio. He was able to provide a pleasant ride while educating us throughout the tour. We saw all the highlights and some hidden gems. Emilio had a great personality which added to the experience.
author: maureen_m
